notes: Upload a photo of a lost or found pet and it searches the national database of lost and found pets by facial recognition. Free. Recommended by the Mayor's Alliance alongside filing a report with the city's shelter. A reviewer confirmed this on the organization's own site on 2026-11-03. The site shows automated checks a bot test, so the weekly check cannot read it and a person re-confirms it instead.
